test_title: PYST 26 - SSC CHSL 2025 - General Intelligence (Held On: 21 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: P walks 30 km towards north. He turns right and walks 60 km. He again turns right and walks 30 km. How far (in km) and in which direction is he now from the starting point?
solution:
**Given:**

P walks 30 km towards north.

He turns right and walks 60 km.

He again turns right and walks 30 km.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b5266e09e41ce8cccd329540ba40e5852a27f88af82f854a571d654df127337.png] 

P is 60 km to the East now from the starting point.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
